organism.scientific: Acacia senegal (gum arabic), Cyamopsis tetragonoloba (guar gum)

provenance_summary: V1-B biological expansion wave. Plant gums (gum arabic, guar gum, xanthan) as bio-adsorbents for heavy metals and dyes. Rich in hydroxyl and carboxyl groups.

mechanisms.name: Plant gum polysaccharide adsorption
mechanisms.description: Plant gum polysaccharides with hydroxyl and carboxyl groups coordinate heavy metals and cationic dyes

pollutant_feature.text: Heavy metal ions and cationic dyes

bio_structure.text: Plant gum polysaccharide with hydroxyl and carboxyl groups

interaction.text: Coordination and electrostatic interaction with functional groups

why_it_works.text: Abundant hydroxyl and carboxyl groups provide binding sites

causal_chain.transferable_principle: Plant gum polysaccharides provide hydroxyl and carboxyl groups for heavy metal coordination

engineering_constraints.description: Plant gum extraction: water dissolution and purification from plant exudates

narrative.text: Plant gums are natural polysaccharides exuded by plants. Gum arabic, guar gum, and xanthan are widely used in food and pharmaceutical industries. Their hydroxyl and carboxyl groups make them effective bio-adsorbents.

design_translation.idea: Use plant gums (gum arabic, guar gum) as bio-adsorbents for heavy metals and dyes
examples: Guar gum hydrogel for dye removal
design_translation.applicability: Heavy metal and dye removal from wastewater
